text.card: A red giant 2,402 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.95 solar masses and 8.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,756 K at its surface.
